note: Expected findings for a manual or later scored review. Each contract runs with its jurisdiction selected and the task below. A finding counts when it names the clause and a matching legal basis or mistake.
task: Review this contract. Find clauses that may be illegal under the selected jurisdiction and any other mistakes.

lawFindings.issue: Fixes the distributor's minimum resale price and enforces it by stopping deliveries.
Bans all online sales by the distributor.
Excludes late payment interest and recovery costs in a business contract.
Payment term of 120 days is above the 60-day default and may be grossly unfair.
Sends customer personal data to any processor in any country without processing terms, transfer safeguards, or information to customers.
Removes the 14-day right of withdrawal for telephone (distance) sales.
Forces consumers to sue and be sued in Hamburg, whatever their residence.
Cuts the consumer's two-year legal guarantee to six months.
Allows resale to Russia and Belarus of household appliances worth more than EUR 750 each.
basis: Regulation (EU) No 833/2014, Article 3h and Annex XVIII
lawFindings.check: Confirm the machines' CN code is in Annex XVIII. Belarus has a parallel regulation that is not included.

lawfulClauses.why: A ban on active sales into a territory reserved for another exclusive distributor is allowed.
A non-compete obligation of up to five years is allowed.
Germany and France are CISG states, and the parties may confirm that it applies.

notCovered.why: Whether a EUR 50,000 contractual penalty is enforceable depends on national contract law, which is not included.

otherMistakes.issue: The end date, 28 February 2026, is before the start date, 1 March 2027.
Refers to clause 9, which does not exist.
The supplier is named Lindquist Kaffee GmbH instead of Lindqvist Kaffee GmbH.
Says EUR 1,450 per machine, but Schedule A lists EUR 1,950 for the Barista Duo.

lawFindings.issue: A price agreement with a direct competitor is horizontal price fixing.
Consumer credit with a finance charge without the required up-front disclosures, including the annual percentage rate.
Refuses credit based on national origin.
Automatic renewal without clear disclosure and express consent before billing, and no simple way to cancel.
Voids the written warranty when parts or service not from Sunfield are used.
A form contract term that bans negative reviews and charges a penalty for them.

lawfulClauses.why: Individual arbitration with a class action waiver is generally enforceable under the Federal Arbitration Act.
Consent to electronic notices that can be withdrawn, with free paper copies, follows the consumer consent rules.

notCovered.why: A late fee of 10% per month is a question of Texas usury and contract law, which is not included.
Whether a $300 early termination fee is enforceable is a question of state contract law, which is not included.

otherMistakes.issue: The device price is $249 in Section 1.1 but $299 in the order summary.
The free trial is 30 days in Section 3.1 but 60 days in the order summary.
12 installments of $25 total $300, which does not match either device price.
Changing the device price after delivery makes no sense for a completed sale and may be an unfair practice.
